oral_examination.oral_examination: In the mouth, there is underlying impaction, the surrounding gums are red and swollen, the blind pocket is deep, and pus overflows.

treatment_plan.definitive: 1. Apply local irrigation and medicine; 2. Give antibiotic drip/oral antibiotics throughout the body; 3. Remove as soon as possible after the inflammation is eliminated.

source_handle: 38. Alternate local flushing with hydrogen peroxide and normal saline, and apply iodine mixture in the blind bag. Once the inflammation has subsided, make an appointment with a surgeon to remove the impacted tooth.
